annotations.title: Check whether a price is good

description: Judge a price someone was offered for a product (for example a store's promotion) against TagDip's price history and today's cheapest store: lowest ever, very good, good, typical or high, with the reasons. Pass product_id or url, and the price in złoty. Documentation: https://tagdip.pl/ai

price_pln.description: The price to check, in złoty.

store.description: The store offering this price, if known.

url.description: Instead of product_id: a tagdip.pl product page, or a product page of a Polish store TagDip tracks.

name: check_price
title: Check whether a price is good
